title: AND Gate
description: Implement a 2-input AND gate. Output is high only when both inputs are high.

title: OR Gate
description: Implement a 2-input OR gate. Output is high when at least one input is high.

title: NAND Gate
description: Implement a 2-input NAND gate. Output is low only when both inputs are high.

title: NOR Gate
description: Implement a 2-input NOR gate. Output is high only when both inputs are low.
testbench: similar to NAND with different truth table

title: XOR Gate
description: Implement a 2-input XOR gate. Output is high when inputs are different.

title: XNOR Gate
description: Implement a 2-input XNOR gate. Output is high when inputs are same.
testbench: similar to XOR with inverted output

title: NOT Gate (Inverter)
description: Implement a single input NOT gate. Output is inverted input.

title: 4-bit Vector NOT
description: Implement a 4-bit vector NOT gate. Invert all bits of input vector.

title: 2-to-1 Multiplexer
description: Implement a 2-to-1 multiplexer with select line. Output = a when s=0, b when s=1.

title: 4-to-1 Multiplexer
description: Implement a 4-to-1 multiplexer with 2-bit select. Output = in[sel].

title: 1-to-4 Demultiplexer
description: Implement a 1-to-4 demultiplexer. Route input to one of 4 outputs based on select.
hint: Set only selected output to input

title: 8-to-3 Priority Encoder
description: Implement an 8-to-3 priority encoder. Output binary code of highest priority active input.

title: 3-to-8 Decoder
description: Implement a 3-to-8 decoder. Exactly one output is high based on 3-bit input.

title: 4-bit Comparator
description: Implement a 4-bit magnitude comparator. Output gt, eq, lt signals.

title: Half Adder
description: Implement a half adder: sum = a XOR b, carry = a AND b.
hint: XOR for sum, AND for carry

title: Full Adder
description: Implement a full adder with carry-in. sum = a XOR b XOR cin, cout = (a&b)|(b&cin)|(a&cin).

title: 4-bit Ripple Carry Adder
description: Implement a 4-bit ripple carry adder using full adders.

title: 4-bit Carry Look Ahead Adder
description: Implement a 4-bit carry look ahead adder for faster addition.

title: Half Subtractor
description: Implement a half subtractor: diff = a XOR b, borrow = ~a & b.
hint: Similar to half adder but different borrow

title: Full Subtractor
description: Implement a full subtractor with borrow-in.
hint: Similar to full adder but different borrow

title: D Flip-Flop
description: Implement positive-edge triggered D flip-flop.

title: D Flip-Flop with Async Reset
description: D flip-flop with asynchronous active-low reset.

title: JK Flip-Flop
description: Implement JK flip-flop with truth table: 00=hold, 01=reset, 10=set, 11=toggle.
hint: Use case statement for JK truth table

title: T Flip-Flop
description: Implement T flip-flop: toggles when T=1, holds when T=0.

title: SR Latch (NAND based)
description: Implement SR latch using NAND gates. S=1,R=0 sets Q=1; S=0,R=1 resets Q=0.

title: 4-bit Register
description: Implement a 4-bit register using D flip-flops.

title: SISO Shift Register
description: Serial In Serial Out shift register. Data shifts right on each clock.

title: SIPO Shift Register
description: Serial In Parallel Out shift register.

title: PISO Shift Register
description: Parallel In Serial Out shift register with load control.

title: PIPO Shift Register
description: Parallel In Parallel Out shift register (basically a register).

title: Johnson Counter
description: Implement a 4-bit Johnson (twisted ring) counter.

title: Ring Counter
description: Implement a 4-bit ring counter (circulating shift register).

title: 4-bit Binary Counter
description: Implement a 4-bit binary up counter.

title: 4-bit Up/Down Counter
description: Implement a 4-bit counter with up/down control.
testbench: test both up and down modes

title: Mealy FSM Sequence Detector
description: Implement Mealy FSM to detect sequence 101.

title: Moore FSM Sequence Detector
description: Implement Moore FSM to detect sequence 1101.

title: Traffic Light FSM
description: Implement FSM for simple traffic light (R->G->Y->R).

title: Synchronous FIFO (4x8)
description: Implement 4-entry x 8-bit synchronous FIFO.

title: 16x8 RAM
description: Implement 16-location x 8-bit RAM with read/write.

title: Binary to Gray Code Converter
description: Convert 4-bit binary to Gray code.
hint: MSB same, others XOR with next higher bit

title: Gray to Binary Converter
description: Convert 4-bit Gray code to binary.

title: BCD to Excess-3 Converter
description: Convert 4-bit BCD to Excess-3 code.

title: Excess-3 to BCD Converter
description: Convert Excess-3 code back to BCD.

title: 4-to-2 Priority Encoder
description: Priority encoder with 4 inputs, 2 outputs, and valid signal.

title: 4-bit Parity Generator
description: Generate even parity bit for 4-bit data.

title: Parity Checker
description: Check 5-bit word (4 data + 1 parity) for even parity error.

title: 7-Segment Decoder
description: Convert 4-bit BCD to 7-segment display outputs (a-g).

title: Simple ALU
description: 4-bit ALU with operations: ADD, SUB, AND, OR.

title: 4-bit Array Multiplier
description: Multiply two 4-bit numbers to produce 8-bit result.

title: 4-bit Restoring Divider
description: Divide 8-bit dividend by 4-bit divisor (restoring algorithm).

title: 8-bit LFSR
description: 8-bit Linear Feedback Shift Register for pseudo-random sequence.

title: Clock Divider
description: Divide input clock by 4 to produce slower output clock.

title: Switch Debouncer
description: Debounce mechanical switch input (4ms debounce time).
